paragraphs.text: Bobblehead is an artifact type introduced in Fallout .
Vault-Tec bobblehead figures are promotional Vault-Tec items, found on the eastern side of the former United States, in the wastelands of the Fallout Universe .

Each of the seven Bobbleheads represents one of the Fallout series primary statistics . Each can tap for mana of any color and has an activated ability that grows stronger based on the number of different Bobbleheads you control. 500 Serialized versions of each were also released in the set.
Aside from their appearances on their cards, melting versions of two bobbleheads also appear in the art for Austere Command .
